title: Kiro Horror Quiz Show — Stage protocol khqs.stage/1
description: Engine (server) ↔ stage (main screen) WebSocket messages. The root validates one message. Scenario files use #/$defs/scenario.

fanType.description: Monster fan puppet type. Assigned by the engine at join and fixed for the game

timeoutMs.description: Only the opening is long (about 50 s); the rest are mostly 5-12 s

assetId.description: Opaque id. No names that hint at the answer

number.description: Question number in the whole game (1-8)

textHidden.description: true: the info board shows no text until the reading ends (text is null too)

selection.description: tied_random: picked at random among those tied for the lowest score. Never say 'last place' on screen or in speech

sseq.description: Stage stream sequence. +1 for every message sent to the stage channel in this game, no gaps

ev:show.opening.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:act.started.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

allOf.description: A buzzer question's text is not sent until the reading ends

ev:question.presented.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:ox.choices_revealed.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:betrayal.offered.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:betrayal.decided.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:answer.revealed.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:score.settled.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:buzzer.judged.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:av.hint.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:final.category.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:final.choices_revealed.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:final.bet_revealed.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

ev:finale.winner.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

standings.description: Ascending rank (ties by seat number). The stage finale is drawn from this array alone

ev:finale.results.description: Gate event: the stage sends stage.beat_done when its animation ends

utteranceId.description: One MC utterance. A later message with the same id replaces the earlier text

text.description: MC sentence heard so far (cumulative). The engine filters out unrevealed answers and hidden text

ev:snapshot.description: Full current state. sseq means 'the stream up to this point' and is not incremented (resend reference point).

engineMessage.description: Engine → stage. Stream messages carry sseq/at; control messages (pong, error) have no sseq

role.description: Only the primary's gate replies count

skipped.description: true if it jumped straight to the rest pose
